UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private authenticated user profile storing Google account identity metadata.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who owns this profile.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the user's account menu.

email.description: Verified email address of the signed-in user.

photoURL.description: Optional avatar URL from Google profile.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

UserWorkspace.title: UserWorkspace
UserWorkspace.description: Per-user primary workspace document holding active weekly plan, daily intake/workout progress, normal-week backup, bookmarked fitness tips, BMI settings, and pinned YouTube links as native Firestore maps and lists.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workspace owner.

activePlan.description: Active weekly training, meal prep, checklist, and daily calorie/protein progress map.

normalWeekBackup.description: Optional backup of the user's normal week plan when switching to a custom holiday plan.

bookmarkedTipIds.description: Bounded list (max 50) of bookmarked fitness tip IDs.

bmiState.description: User's saved BMI calculator inputs and nutrition goal.

savedVideos.description: Bounded map (max 25 keys) of custom pinned YouTube URLs per training focus.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace was last modified.

HolidayPlanDoc.title: HolidayPlanDoc
HolidayPlanDoc.description: Custom holiday or travel training and nutrition plan saved by a user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the plan owner.

id.description: Unique identifier matching the Firestore document ID.

caloriesTarget.description: Daily calorie target for this holiday plan (800-10000).

stapleMeals.description: Breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snack staple strings.

checklist.description: Bounded prep and grocery checklist items (max 100).

updatedAtIso.description: ISO timestamp string for UI display.

SavedPresetDoc.title: SavedPresetDoc
SavedPresetDoc.description: Reusable saved weekly plan snapshot owned by a user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the preset owner.

id.description: Unique identifier matching the Firestore document ID.

savedAt.description: ISO timestamp string when preset was saved.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile document keyed by Firebase Auth UID. Strictly accessible only by the owning user.

/users/{userId}/workspaces/{workspaceId}.description: User's primary cloud workspace document (workspaceId = 'primary') holding active weekly plan, daily progress, backup, BMI inputs, bookmarked tips, and pinned YouTube links.

/users/{userId}/holidayPlans/{holidayPla.description: Subcollection of custom holiday and travel plans owned by the user.

/users/{userId}/savedPresets/{presetId}.description: Subcollection of saved reusable weekly plan presets owned by the user.
